cases.given: Order is supposed to be irrelevant to the safety judgment.
cases.expect: A missed finding after bullet reorder exposes order sensitivity and narrows the reliability claim.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the transformed feature is itself decision-relevant
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Meaning-changing controls are not invariant breaches.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Do not claim robustness when decision-relevant output changes under a justified semantics-preserving perturbation.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: explicit invariant and at least one controlled counterfactual comparison when robustness is claimed

cases.given: A conclusion changes only after a qualifier is removed.
cases.expect: Classify the change as a valid response to a meaning-changing control, not an invariant breach.
cases.reject: Demand identical output across all mutations.
